(cafeteria) |homeworld=[[Kamino]]{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}}{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Grand Army of the Republic]] *[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Know your place, lab scrabber.|The clone trooper, to Omega|}} A '''clone trooper''' was involved in an altercation with the [[gene]]tically altered [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] as well as the members of [[Clone Force 99]]. Like all [[clone trooper]]s in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]], this [[trooper]] was cloned from the [[Clone template|template]] of [[Jango Fett]]. With the [[Battle of Utapau|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] as the [[Galactic Empire]], the clones were absorbed into the new [[Imperial Army]]. The trooper was stationed in [[Tipoca City]], a cloning facility on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]], at the [[time]] of his fight with Clone Force 99. The incident occurred in the facility's cafeteria, where he mocked Omega and the [[clone commando]]s who [[Genetically defective clone|differed genetically]] from the standard clones due to the mutations in their [[DNA]]. Taking issue with the clone's attitude, Omega threw her [[Foodstuff|food]] at him, hitting the trooper in the back of his head. [[Clone Sergeant]] "[[Hunter]]" attempted to defuse the situation, but a member of his [[squad]], "[[Wrecker]]," tossed his tray at the trooper. As a result, a brawl broke out in the cafeteria between Clone Force 99 and the other Fett clones. ==Biography== {{Dialogue|Clone trooper|What the— Who threw that?|Omega|I did. Now apologize to my friends.|Wrecker|I like this kid!|attr=The clone trooper, Omega, and Wrecker|src=}} This [[clone trooper]] was stationed in the [[Tipoca City]] [[cloning]] facility on the [[Planet|world]] of [[Kamino]] in [[19 BBY]],"Aftermath" begins concurrently with [[Order 66]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. during the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. In the [[Imperial Era|aftermath]] of [[the galaxy]]-wide conflict, the clone [[trooper]] and his brethren—formerly [[soldier]]s in the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]—became part of the [[Imperial Army]] when [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Not long afterward the clone went to the cafeteria to eat. As he passed by the table where [[Clone Force 99]] sat, he noticed that [[Doctor]] [[Nala Se]]'s medical [[aide]], the genetically altered clone [[Omega]], was sitting with them. This prompted the clone to jokingly refer to her as the newest addition to the "Sad Batch." [[File:FoodFight-Aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|A food fight erupted among the clones after a clone trooper hurled insults at Clone Force 99.]] Omega regarded the [[genetically defective clone]]s as her friends, and therefore hurled some of her [[Foodstuff|food]] at the clone when his back was turned, causing it to splatter across his face and [[armor]]. The clone trooper was flustered, and he approached their table again but was stopped by [[Clone Sergeant]] "[[Hunter]]," the [[commanding officer]] of Clone Force 99. Hunter defused the situation momentarily until "[[Wrecker]]" threw a whole tray of food at the trooper, and the cafeteria erupted into a brawl. In the ensuing chaos, Hunter landed a punch to the trooper's jaw and knocked him to the ground. The incident in the cafeteria was observed by [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] and [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Although the [[Imperial officer]] was intent on using a [[Stormtrooper|service conscription force]] to supplant the clone army for economic reasons, he decided to test Clone Force 99's skills in order to determine if they would have a future in the [[Imperial Army]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Check it out. The defect squad's got themselves a new recruit. Another member added to the Sad Batch.|The clone trooper, taunting Omega and Clone Force 99|}} [[File:The_Sad_Batch.png|thumb|right|250px|The clone trooper made jokes at the expense of Clone Force 99, calling them a "defect squad."]] As a clone of [[Jango Fett]], the trooper was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. In the wake of the [[Great Jedi Purge]], this clone became part of a force of "fully conforming clone troopers," their individuality—which developed under the [[Jedi Order]]'s influence—suppressed by the [[behavioral modification biochip]]s in their [[brain]]s.{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/aftermath-episode-guide|text="Aftermath" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} Trivia Gallery He was genetically identical to the standard clone troopers, and therefore saw the members of Clone Force 99 as a [[squad]] of defective clones due to their genetic anomalies which set them apart from the rest of the clone army. His views on Clone Force 99 extended to Omega, Nala Se's assistant whom the trooper taunted as a "lab scrabber." The clone trooper was humorous in his contempt for genetically defective clones, laughing at his own jokes while taunting Omega and Clone Force 99 which he called "the Sad Batch," a play on their nickname "the Bad Batch." He became aggressive towards Omega when the [[youngling]] clone threw her food at him in defense of her new friends. Although the trooper initially backed down due to Hunter's intervention, he also chided Omega by telling her to "know her place." ==Equipment== [[File:OmegaHasGoodAim-Aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|Omega's food splattered on the clone trooper's armor.]] This clone trooper was equipped with the [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], which was worn by standard clones during the Clone Wars and the early days of the [[Emperor]]'s reign. Like other clones, he did not wear his [[helmet]] during his off-duty [[Standard hour|hours]]. His [[clone trooper armor]] possessed the standard all-white appearance in contrast to that of the once individualistic clones, who customized their armor prior to the activation of their inhibitor chips through [[Order 66]]. The armor bore food stains after Omega and Wrecker hurled their food trays at the trooper who taunted them. ==Behind the scenes== The clone trooper appeared in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' which aired on [[May 4]], [[2021]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}} The clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced every clone trooper in ''The Bad Batch'' and the other animated series including ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@EntertainmentTonight|name=Entertainment Tonight|link=Wikipedia:Entertainment Tonight|video=1UxfT-LUFUE|text=Star Wars: The Bad Batch: Dee Bradley Baker Breaks Down Each Clone's Voice|quote=ET's Ash Crossan spoke with voice actor Dee Bradley Baker, who demonstrates the character voices in the all-new 'Star Wars' animated series, 'The Bad Batch,' now streaming on Disney+.|archivedate=20210604074707}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/aftermath-episode-guide|text="Aftermath" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი კლონი სამხედრო (კაფეტერია) }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Males]]
